ai.title: ads API defaults sessionId to userId when missing
ai.summary: The `postAds` handler in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts` now assigns `sessionId: sessionId ?? userId` to the request body, replacing the previous conditional spread that omitted `sessionId` entirely when absent. This ensures the downstream ads service always receives a valid session identifier, preventing potential mismatches or errors in ad placement tracking for unauthenticated or session-less requests.

eli5.text: When ads need a session identifier but none exists, the system now uses your user id instead of leaving that field blank. This prevents ad placement tracking from failing during unauthenticated or session-less requests. No visible action is required from you today; the correction happens automatically behind the scenes.

ai.summary: Corrected Gravity API response handling in `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/_post.ts`. The code now expects an object with an `ads` array instead of a single ad object, extracting `ads[0]` for processing. This fixes potential errors when parsing the JSON body.

ai.summary: Pasted text in the CLI is converted into a pending attachment card, mirroring image paste behavior. The `onPasteLongText` handler in `cli/src/chat.tsx` adds the text to the store, and new `TextAttachmentCard` and `PendingAttachmentsBanner` components display it. This change affects the input flow and message rendering in `cli/src/components/message-block.tsx` and related UI files.

eli5.text: When you paste text into the command-line version of Claude, it now shows up as a little preview card the same way images do, instead of dropping straight into the chat box. If the pasted text is long, you'll see a small banner near your input area showing a brief snippet and character count, and you can review or dismiss it before sending. This makes big blocks of pasted text easier to control and less likely to flood your message by accident. The feature is live today for anyone using the CLI.

ai.title: CLI supports slashless init, new, help, logout, exit commands
ai.summary: Router now parses slashless exact matches for init, new, help, logout, and exit via parseCommandInput in cli/src/commands/router-utils.ts. Input matching SLASHLESS_COMMAND_IDS from cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts triggers command execution without a leading slash, while multi-word slashless input remains a normal message. Scope is CLI only; slash commands and referral codes unchanged. ImplicitCommand flag added to SlashCommand interface and analytics payload distinguishes slashless invocations.

eli5.text: You can now run a handful of quick setup commands by typing them plainly, without first typing a slash. For example, type "init" by itself and the assistant will create your starter file, "new" clears the conversation, "help" shows tips, "logout" signs you out, and "exit" quits. Anything that has extra words or isn't one of those exact phrases still acts as a normal message, so your usual questions and instructions work exactly as before. The change is live today in the command-line program, and the team records these slash-free runs separately from the old /commands you type with a slash.

ai.title: Enforce minimum 0.02 credits for ad impressions
ai.summary: Added `MINIMUM_CREDITS_GRANTED` constant (0.02) to `web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/_post.ts`. Credit calculation now uses `Math.max` to ensure payouts below the threshold still grant 0.02 credits, preventing zero-value grants from low-payout impressions. Scope limited to the server-side impression handler.

eli5.text: Advertisements now always grant at least the smallest possible reward, a fraction of a cent, even when an ad's payout is so tiny that rounding would normally give you nothing. The system previously calculated your earnings and rounded down, which could drop very low payouts to zero, so now it keeps that minimum floor in place before the final number is settled. This affects anyone earning money from ad impressions on the platform today.

ai.title: Bump Freebuff CLI to version 1.0.583
ai.summary: Version bumped to 1.0.583 in `cli/release/package.json` as a release-bump commit. This release bundles user-visible changes from the surrounding commit sequence: CLI logout now deletes web sessions and unlinks fingerprints via new `web/src/app/api/auth/cli/logout/` modules, pasted text converts to a `TextAttachmentCard` in the input flow, and slashless init/new/help/logout/exit commands parse via `parseCommandInput` in `cli/src/commands/router-utils.ts`. Additional changes include full-width center-aligned file stats bars in `cli/src/components/implementor-row.tsx`, static generation for docs and web routes, JSON-LD structured data on web pages, and new `SESSSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` and `SESSION_TIME_WINDOW_MS` constants in `common/src/old-constants.ts` supporting the CLI logout time-window deletion flow.
ai.evidence: Commit 767cc7ad modifies only `cli/release/package.json`, changing the version field from 1.0.582 to 1.0.583 (a +1/-1 line diff). The commit is tagged 'release-bump' and analyzed notes confirm 'Bump version to 1.0.583'.

eli5.text: This release improves the look, feel, and reliability of the Freebuff CLI and its web tools. You can now type common commands like init, new, help, logout, and exit without needing a slash prefix, and pasted text appears as a tidy attachment card just like pasted images. The file stats display was redesigned with full-width bars that meet in the center, making additions and removals easier to read at a glance. Researcher agents now start collapsed by default to keep your workspace clean, and the built-in CLI tester agent was renamed for clarity. When you log out of the CLI, your web sessions are also cleared automatically for better security. Under the hood, ad payouts now have a minimum credit guarantee, SEO structured data was added to more web pages, and new end-to-end tests help catch bugs before they reach you. Upgrading gives you a faster, safer, and more polished experience across both the terminal and web interfaces.

ai.summary: Deleted 6 `logger.info` calls from `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx` and `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`. Removes '[gravity]' prefixed logs for AdBanner rendering, impression recording, rotation cycles, pause/resume states, and first-message detection. Reduces CLI console noise during ad lifecycle events.

eli5.text: When you use the command-line tool and an ad is being shown to you, the tool used to print a series of short status messages in your terminal (prefixed with '[gravity]') for each step of the ad, like when the ad appears, when it counts an impression, when it cycles to the next ad, and when it pauses or resumes the ad rotation.
